synopsis: Sandsea Moogle Kupo! A gathering of the Urutan-Yensa! / Sandsea Moogle A truly rare occurrence, kupo! / Sandsea Moogle ...Kupo? Kupo-po!? / Sandsea Moogle Wait, what's happening, kupo!? / Sandsea Moogle Wait! No! They're going to execute him! / Sandsea Moogle Don't do this! The creature would still be at large if it weren't for his plea for help, kupo! / Queen of the Urutan You shame us by seeking aid outside the tribe! Urutan-Yensa are lords and masters of the great sea! We seek the aid of none! / Queen of the Urutan Your words are the howling of the sand to my ears! I condemn you to dust! / Sandsea Moogle (gasp) / Sandsea Moogle Wh-Wh-What have you done, kupo!? / Sandsea Moogle You bring him back! / Queen of the Urutan Those who sully our name will be punished, be they foeman or kin. They must pay the honor-price. There can be no forgiveness! I would destroy you, too...but I am merciful. Better you live to tell the world that the Urutan are not to be taken lightly. Now, leave!
plays_when: in The Sandscale Bank (Nam-Yensa Sandsea), when the party arrives while quest 13's stage is 140 (the map's setup then sets a file variable to 1, enw_a05 lines 1238 and 1240, its only store): the map's script reads and starts it under its test of that variable (enw_a05 lines 1496, 1513 and 1523), and then sets quest 13's stage to 150 (line 1532), so the setup's test of stage 140 no longer passes.

synopsis: So we've drawn you out at last! / The moth cannot resist the flame. Now you will burn! / Long time no see, Balthier! / I've been biding my time trolling for hunters. So long you've kept me waiting! / I was beginning to think you didn't care! / You are looking rather careworn. / Are the lizards in the sandpits not company enough for you? / My blade requires a sharper tongue to keep its edge!
plays_when: in Withering Shores (Nam-Yensa Sandsea), when the party walks into the area that starts the fight (set at enw_c01 line 914; its touch starts the fight at line 1001) while the hunt A Dark Rumor (quest 172) is under way (the area and its touch act only while the hunt's flag, global word 0xA78, is 1, enw_c01 lines 912 and 960): the battle with Ba'Gamnan begins with this scene. The script reads and starts it on arrival (enw_c01 lines 452 and 456), and it holds (enw_c0100 line 36) until that releases it (enw_c01 line 500). Montblanc sets the hunt's flag to 1 when he gives the hunt in the Clan Hall (Rabanastre) (rbn_a14 line 4231, the hunt's case, and lines 4236 and 4237); its only store of 2 is in this map's script (enw_c01 line 745). The script skips the reads only at story counter 0 and from 11000 (After the end of FFXII) (the test at line 435 returns before them, line 446). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 379) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 402 and 413).

synopsis: On Withering Shores Ba'Gamnan speaks three voiced lines to the party leader, two members and the guest over five cuts while his gang (Bwagi, Gijuk, Rinok) stays hidden, three Yensa (Ensa_A to Ensa_C) move in during the last cut, and the battle camera leads into the fight.
plays_when: in Withering Shores (Nam-Yensa Sandsea), when Ba'Gamnan is defeated: the script starts it on arrival together with the opening scene (enw_c01 lines 454 and 457), and it holds (enw_c0101 line 38) until the script releases it after the win (enw_c01 line 588). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 379) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 402 and 413).
